query: SELECT reasoning_depth, baseline, uses_reranker FROM cspaper WHERE (baseline != 'ChatGPT' AND retrieval_method = 'Hybrid Retrieval; Dense Retrieval') OR (baseline = 'RAPTOR; Embed' AND baseline != 'Llama2-7B; Llama2-13B; SAIL-7B; Alpaca-7B; Alpaca-13B; ChatGPT; CoVE65B; RAG-ChatGPT; RAG 2.0; RAG-Command R+; RQ-RAG7B(ToT); Perplexity.ai; Self-RAG-7B; Self-RAG-13B; LongChat-13B');
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。

nodes.detail: (baseline <> 'ChatGPT' AND retrieval_method = 'Hybrid Retrieval; Dense Retrieval') OR (baseline = 'RAPTOR; Embed' AND baseline <> 'Llama2-7B; Llama2-13B; SAIL-7B; Alpaca-7B; Alpaca-13B; ChatGPT; CoVE65B; RAG-ChatGPT; RAG 2.0; RAG-Command R+; RQ-RAG7B(ToT); Perplexity.ai; Self-RAG-7B; Self-RAG-13B; LongChat-13B')
